kind_of_no: AWH-dropped entry 6013 (same place); camping is a WMA allowance with no designated sites
why: This lead is the former DB entry 6013 Warsing Dam Campground (pin 47.83430,-99.10950, ~0.5 km from the lead's RV Life point), dropped by AWH 2026-11-12 ('Drop Warsing Dam'; audit/verify/removals.json). Re-checked 2026-11-21: no official source designates campsites. ND Game and Fish lists Warsing Dam as an 86-acre WMA, '1 mile northeast of Sheyenne. Overnight camping prohibited Tuesdays and Wednesdays, except holidays' (gf.nd.gov/wma-listing, and gf.nd.gov/wma's Thursday-Monday list), which is the general WMA camping allowance. G&F's Fishing Facilities layer (ndgishub GNF_FishingWaters layer 4) lists only a vault toilet, a T-shaped floating pier, a concrete ramp, a dock and a spillway, with no campsites, and names Eddy County Park Board as owner of the pier, ramp and dock. Not on the ND HHS licensed RV park/campground list (07.17.2025; Eddy County rows are New Rockford and Sheyenne RV Park only). No Eddy County web page exists. The only site counts are directories (AllStays 5 sites, tables and toilets, tents; ndtourism is never a source). Esri imagery shows two gravel loops among trees with picnic shelters and a vault toilet, and no pads or parked RVs. Under the wildlife-agency rule, an allowance with no agency designation is out.
name: Warsing Dam Campground
flags: New since AWH's 2026-11-12 drop, which rested on 'likely closed to overnight camping': ND Game and Fish's WMA listing (read 2026-11-21) says camping is allowed on Warsing Dam WMA Thursday to Monday, so the 'closed overnight' sign a camper saw (Campendium, July 2024) may be the Tuesday/Wednesday ban or the park-hours sign rather than a full closure. The New Rockford Transcript of 2018-01-22 reports a G&F warden recommending the Tuesday/Wednesday ban and replacing the faded park-hours sign. The 2023-04-10 issue reports the county replacing both toilets, with Commissioner Glenda Collier saying 'people are encouraged to camp out there and take the kids fishing'. So the closure doubt is weaker than it was, but nothing official designates campsites. The skip now rests on the designation gap, not on a closure.

Possible ownership if it is ever revisited: G&F manages the WMA land and fishery, and the Eddy County Park Board owns the ramp, dock and pier and runs the loops and toilets. That makes it `local`, like 5951 McGregor and 6011 Short Creek. Directory phone 701-996-3661 (Campendium, The Dyrt, AllStays), not verified as the county's. A call to Eddy County would settle whether the loops are designated camp sites, but that is phone-only.

Waterfront (only if ever re-added): the 2026-11-21 imagery shows the east loop's road running ~10-30 m from the south shore across open grass and a reed fringe, with no pads visible. Stored value was lakefront, which the p3-448 reviewer judged would go down. Not audited further.
